subject: physics
title: Взвешивание во влажном воздухе
statement: Brass weights are used to weigh an aluminum-made sample on an analytical balance. The weighing is ones in dry air and another time in humid air with the water vapor pressure $P_h =2\cdot10^3$ Pa. The total atmospheric pressure ($P = 10^5$ Pa) and the temperature ($t =20^\circ$ C) are the same in both cases. What should the mass of the sample be to be able to tell the difference in the balance readings provided their sensitivity is $m_0 = 0.1$ mg? Aluminum density $\rho_1= 2700$ kg/m$^3$, brass density $\rho_2=.8500$ kg/m$^3$.
